args.subject: Welcome to Acme Lab
args.textBody:
Hi Frank,

Welcome to Acme Lab! We're delighted to have you joining us as a data engineer.

Your start date is Tuesday, December 1, 2026. Your onboarding buddy will be Erin Park, who will help you get settled in and answer any questions during your first weeks.

If you need anything before then, just reply to this email.

Looking forward to working with you.

Best,
Dana
